summary: Hosted generation adapts the shared DurableRunEngine to Cloudflare persistence and existing product projections. Provider protocol stays in adapters/portable provider modules; this directory does not define another Run domain.

key_files.start.ts: Live HTTP/agent/NodeProcessor admission entrypoint; dispatches through runtime, never calls a blocking adapter.
key_files.runtime.ts: Freezes input/account references, journals before scheduling, rechecks node admission before submit, drives shared retry/transition policy and lifecycle hook checkpoints.
key_files.adapter.ts: One submit or one status poll per invocation. Tokens are private JSON; completed media contains receipt-backed handles.
key_files.context.ts: Invocation-only reference reads and output broker IO. No Workflow steps, journal mutations, D1 Assets or Canvas publication.
key_files.output.ts: R2 immutable byte/receipt CAS scoped by Project and shared run/slot identity. Primary media and optional provider covers have separate verified receipts.
key_files.publication.ts: Owner and task/output checks, immutable legacy D1 Asset preparation, detached shared Canvas operation; ProjectRoom acknowledges durable append before asset_ref visibility.
key_files.status.ts: Journal-backed public task status overrides legacy Asset-row hints, including text success and obsolete-target failure.
key_files.recovery.ts: Scheduled recovery of due journal runs using the existing Workflow ID; runtime admission remains authoritative before any provider submission.
key_files.registry.ts: Supported hosted wire adapters; plugin-owned routes stay explicitly unsupported here and use the local executable-plugin Host.
key_files.adapters: Provider translation only. Async services return opaque tokens and never own scheduling.

compatibility: Live GenerationWorkflow uses shared graph and D1/R2 ports while retaining legacy task IDs and D1 Asset/node publication; this is not native Generator Output Commit migration.
Pre-migration Workflow payloads without a durable identity require owner reconciliation; they are never blindly resubmitted.
Hook completion markers prevent ordinary replay, not exactly-once external billing. Billing integrations must deduplicate by taskId.

Provider failure values use the portable action-sdk/executable-failure subpath. Unit-test aliases resolve both SDK root and subpaths to one source implementation, preserving instanceof across adapters and runtime.
